audits.claim_text: The 46 fresh-v4 preparation refusals have distinct causes: 23 generated-contract mismatches, 6 reference/catalog mismatches, 14 intentional unsupported cases, 2 input-model limits and 1 frontend extension candidate.
audits.scope: All 46 preparation REFUSED cases only; first blocker attribution plus secondary findings. Excludes generation failures, parsing errors and search incompleteness from this denominator.

run_selection.selection_rule: All and only 46 REFUSED cases from the frozen fresh-v4 manifest; copied C18_006 explicit-bool probe is separate diagnostic evidence.

excluded_runs.rationale: Different outcome classes, outside the requested refusal-attribution scope; remain in the original benchmark.

check_results.rationale: Post-outcome diagnostic attribution, explicitly separated from frozen benchmark; no claim of prespecified categories.
Each of 46 REFUSED rows has one primary reason; secondary findings overlap. Static contract mismatches are not ground-truth ACTION labels.
No speed or algorithm accuracy comparison is made in this attribution audit.
All and only 46 manifest REFUSED IDs were reproduced with their exact original first-error string; no original outcome changed.
One known finite corpus, post-hoc self-review; counts are descriptive and do not establish whole-language correctness.
Gold IR, generated code and catalog issues separated; early refusals can hide secondary problems, and contract interpretation is not deployment evidence.
Frozen payload/candidate hashes, diagnostic source hashes, catalog returns, stage reproductions and copied-variant probe persisted.
Triage verified source and all 46 candidate hashes before/after diagnostic execution. No production or raw-result mutation.
Same agent performed attribution and review, using current parser/catalog adapters; no independent adjudication.

independence.evidence: Source inspection, exact-refusal reproduction and one diagnostic copied variant by the same agent; not independent semantic validation.

limitations: Primary cause is not the complete set of issues in a case.
Generated-contract mismatch is scoped to current scalar/selector semantics and fixed binding, not universal JoI-language invalidity.
Reference/catalog mismatch requires source-data/specification review, not automatic candidate blame.
C18_006 original remains REFUSED; the edited in-memory copy diverges and is not counted as a new benchmark result.
Missing STRING domain cannot be repaired by treating a few samples as all strings.

predecessor_failures.rationale: Initial relative __file__ snapshot lookup failed before any artifact/probe; resolved using absolute path, then all 46 original refusals reproduced.

audits.minimum_corrective_action: Review six reference/catalog inconsistencies; evaluate BOOL any normalization as a separate frontend change and the two domain limits as explicit model/cost decisions; preserve deliberate refusals and raw outcomes.
